main/review-queue:
usage: aragora review-queue [-h]
                            {build,packet,run,act,record-settlement,evidence-lint,collect-evidence,lint-comment,baseline,merge-packet,conductor,observe-outcomes,health,health-alert}
                            ...

Build a prioritized queue of open PRs, generate an advisory packet, or record an explicit human
settlement action.

-h, --help  show this help message and exit

advanced commands:
  act Settle one PR with a human action

  baseline Measure empirical invalidation baseline from on-disk stores (#6375)

  build Build prioritized review queue from open PRs

  collect-evidence Run genuine model reviewers, lint their evidence, post only if tier allows

  conductor Build an owner-aware queue conductor packet and next prompt

  evidence-lint Dry-run whether a proposed evidence comment will count for model quorum

  health Report freshness across review-queue + proof-loop write surfaces

  health-alert Edge-triggered alerter: writes an event when proof-loop health changes state

  lint-comment Dry-run whether a proposed reviewer comment will count before posting

  merge-packet Print a model-quorum merge authorization packet for a PR batch

  observe-outcomes Observe post-settlement invalidation signals from GitHub timeline events and
  (optionally) write them back into receipt v2 outcome fields. Dry-run by default.

  packet Generate advisory review packet for one PR

  record-settlement Record an already-authorized PR settlement without mutating GitHub

  run Interactively settle a prioritized PR queue

main/review-queue baseline:
usage: aragora review-queue baseline [-h] [--window-days WINDOW_DAYS] [--min-samples MIN_SAMPLES]
                                     [--safety-margin SAFETY_MARGIN]
                                     [--minimum-meaningful-rate MINIMUM_MEANINGFUL_RATE]
                                     [--placeholder-value PLACEHOLDER_VALUE]
                                     [--calibration-db CALIBRATION_DB]
                                     [--review-queue-root REVIEW_QUEUE_ROOT] [--json]

Read the auto-handle calibration store and settlement receipts, compute the empirical invalidation
baseline, and propose an auto-handle invalidation threshold. This command is read-only.

-h, --help              show this help message and exit
--window-days WINDOW_DAYS
                        Measurement-window width in days (default: 30).
--min-samples MIN_SAMPLES
                        Minimum human-settled sample size before using the measured baseline.
--safety-margin SAFETY_MARGIN
                        Multiplier applied to the baseline when deriving the threshold.
--minimum-meaningful-rate MINIMUM_MEANINGFUL_RATE
                        Floor below which threshold drift is indistinguishable from sample noise.
--placeholder-value PLACEHOLDER_VALUE
                        Threshold to use below the sample-size floor (default: 0.05).
--calibration-db CALIBRATION_DB
                        Override the auto-handle calibration store path.
--review-queue-root REVIEW_QUEUE_ROOT
                        Override the review-queue root used for settlement receipts.
--json                  Output the BaselineMeasurement + ThresholdProposal as JSON.

main/review-queue collect-evidence:
usage: aragora review-queue collect-evidence [-h] --pr PR [--repo REPO]
                                             [--reviewers REVIEWERS [REVIEWERS ...]]
                                             [--author AUTHOR] [--apply]
                                             [--reviewer-timeout REVIEWER_TIMEOUT]
                                             [--overall-timeout OVERALL_TIMEOUT] [--json]

Run >=2 genuine heterogeneous model reviewers against a PR's exact head, compose evidence comments
the quorum parsers recognize, and validate each with evidence-lint before posting. Only Tier 0-2
PRs auto-post (with --apply); Tier 3-4 always prepare evidence for operator settlement. Defaults
to a dry run that posts nothing.

-h, --help              show this help message and exit
--pr PR                 PR number to collect evidence for
--repo REPO             owner/name of the target repo (default: current gh context)
--reviewers REVIEWERS [REVIEWERS ...]
                        reviewer model families to run (default: claude grok)
--author AUTHOR         GitHub login to simulate for evidence-lint (default: gh authenticated
                        user)
--apply                 Post evidence for Tier 0-2 PRs (Tier 3-4 always prepare-only).
--reviewer-timeout REVIEWER_TIMEOUT
                        Per-reviewer timeout in seconds for this invocation.
--overall-timeout OVERALL_TIMEOUT
                        Overall reviewer orchestration timeout in seconds for this invocation.
--json                  Output as JSON
main/review-queue conductor:
usage: aragora review-queue conductor [-h] [--limit LIMIT] [--pr PR] [--repo REPO]
                                      [--review-queue-root REVIEW_QUEUE_ROOT]
                                      [--owner-timeout-seconds OWNER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS]
                                      [--mode {queue,ready-boundary}] [--json]

Read-only queue conductor that combines open PR metadata, required checks, branch owner lookup,
operator steering, merge-packet status, head-change detection, and supersession hints into one
JSON packet plus one next prompt.

-h, --help              show this help message and exit

--pr PR                 Specific PR number/ref to include. Repeatable. Defaults to open queue.
--repo REPO             GitHub repo slug override (owner/name). Defaults to current repo context.
--review-queue-root REVIEW_QUEUE_ROOT
                        Override the review-queue store root used for settlement receipt lookups.
--owner-timeout-seconds OWNER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
                        Timeout for owner and steering helper lookup. Timeout means preserve/no-
                        mutate.
--mode {queue,ready-boundary}
                        Conductor routing mode. ready-boundary emits mark-ready authorization
                        classification for draft PRs that are otherwise ready.
--json                  Output as JSON

                                   [--review-queue-root REVIEW_QUEUE_ROOT]

Read-only, network-free check of the write-side daemons that close the proof loop: settlement
receipts, briefs, boss-metrics ledger, automation receipts, boss-loop log, watchdog log, B0

surface silent failures within seconds, not 13 days.

                        Override the .aragora/overnight directory.
--automation-receipts-root AUTOMATION_RECEIPTS_ROOT
                        Override the .aragora/automation-receipts directory.

main/review-queue health-alert:
usage: aragora review-queue health-alert [-h] [--repo-root REPO_ROOT]
                                         [--review-queue-root REVIEW_QUEUE_ROOT]
                                         [--overnight-root OVERNIGHT_ROOT]
                                         [--automation-receipts-root AUTOMATION_RECEIPTS_ROOT]
                                         [--state-dir STATE_DIR] [--heartbeat] [--json]

Runs the same checks as 'review-queue health', persists state under .aragora/proof-loop-alerts/,
and writes one JSON event per state transition (opens, set-change, recovers). Designed to be
invoked on a schedule (e.g. launchd every 15 minutes) without producing repeat alerts while a
surface stays stale. Exits 1 if any surface is currently stale or missing so launchd can surface
failure.

-h, --help              show this help message and exit
--repo-root REPO_ROOT   Override repo root used for status doc + overnight + state lookups.
--review-queue-root REVIEW_QUEUE_ROOT
                        Override the review-queue store root.
--overnight-root OVERNIGHT_ROOT
                        Override the .aragora/overnight directory.
--automation-receipts-root AUTOMATION_RECEIPTS_ROOT
                        Override the .aragora/automation-receipts directory.
--state-dir STATE_DIR   Override the alert state directory (default: <repo>/.aragora/proof-loop-
                        alerts).
--heartbeat             Emit a heartbeat event even when state is unchanged (useful for liveness
                        checks).
--json                  Output the result as JSON (kind, paths, alerting surfaces).

usage: aragora review-queue merge-packet [-h] [--limit LIMIT] [--pr PR] [--repo REPO]

                                         [--execute-reviewers] [--ignore-own-quorum-check]

--limit LIMIT           Max open PRs to inspect when --pr is not supplied
--pr PR                 Specific PR number/ref to include. Repeatable. Defaults to open queue.
--repo REPO             GitHub repo slug override (owner/name). Defaults to current repo context.
--review-queue-root REVIEW_QUEUE_ROOT
                        Override the review-queue store root used for settlement receipt lookups.
--execute-reviewers     Attempt live heterogeneous reviewer execution for each packet.
--ignore-own-quorum-check
                        Diagnostic only: exclude the aragora-merge-quorum check (any state) from
                        the packet's check gating so out-of-CI callers can observe the real model-

                        enforcing CI gate never sets this; it does not weaken the gate.

main/review-queue observe-outcomes:
usage: aragora review-queue observe-outcomes [-h] [--window-days WINDOW_DAYS]
                                             [--max-receipts MAX_RECEIPTS]
                                             [--per-receipt-event-cap PER_RECEIPT_EVENT_CAP]
                                             [--review-queue-root REVIEW_QUEUE_ROOT] [--write]
                                             [--json]

Round 30g phase A. Iterates settled receipts in a bounded window, fetches GitHub timeline events
with bounded fanout, and computes the canonical v2 outcome signals via
aragora.review.settlement_outcome.observe_outcome. Default mode is read-only; --write opts in to
in-place mutation of receipt JSON. Scope: this command observes outcomes; it does NOT close #6375,
does NOT replace the placeholder 5% threshold, and does NOT unblock H2. Operator caution: --write
mutates audit-record receipt JSON in place; do not run this in unattended CI loops.

-h, --help              show this help message and exit
--window-days WINDOW_DAYS
                        Observation window in days (default: 14).
--max-receipts MAX_RECEIPTS
                        Max receipts to inspect (default: 20). Bounds the GitHub fanout.
--per-receipt-event-cap PER_RECEIPT_EVENT_CAP
                        Max timeline events per receipt (default: 100).
--review-queue-root REVIEW_QUEUE_ROOT
                        Override the review-queue store root for settlement receipts.
--write                 OPT-IN: actually write v2 outcome fields back into audit-record receipt
                        JSON in place. Default is dry-run preview only. Do not run this in
                        unattended CI loops; treat each --write invocation as a discrete operator
                        decision.
--json                  Output the run summary as JSON.

main/review-queue record-settlement:
usage: aragora review-queue record-settlement [-h] [--repo REPO] --head-sha HEAD_SHA --action
                                              {approve,request_changes,comment,admin_squash_merge}
                                              --reason REASON
                                              [--review-queue-root REVIEW_QUEUE_ROOT]
                                              [--apply-post-merge-lane-audit]
                                              [--post-github-status]
                                              [--github-status-context GITHUB_STATUS_CONTEXT]
                                              [--json]
                                              pr

Write a local review-queue settlement receipt after an external
operator decision, such as an exact-head admin squash merge. This
is local-only: it verifies the live PR head/state, writes under
.aragora/review-queue/receipts (or --review-queue-root), and does
not approve, comment, merge, or otherwise mutate GitHub.

-h, --help              show this help message and exit
pr                      PR number or URL
--repo REPO             GitHub repo slug override (owner/name). Defaults to current repo context.
--head-sha HEAD_SHA     Exact PR head SHA that was externally settled.
--action {approve,request_changes,comment,admin_squash_merge}
                        Externally observed settlement action to record.
--reason REASON         One-line operator reason or authorization reference.
--review-queue-root REVIEW_QUEUE_ROOT
                        Override the review-queue store root used for settlement receipts.
                        Defaults to <repo>/.aragora/review-queue.
--apply-post-merge-lane-audit
                        For admin_squash_merge records, apply merged-PR lane supersession after
                        verifying GitHub reports MERGED and using the live merge commit as the
                        exact guard. Default is dry-run/report only.
--post-github-status    After the local receipt is durably written, atomically POST the
                        'aragora/human-settlement'=success commit status for the exact head SHA.
                        This is the ONLY GitHub mutation this command performs, and it is the safe
                        replacement for running 'gh api ... statuses' as a separate command: the
                        status can never be set unless the receipt write succeeded first (receipt
                        => status, never status => no receipt). If the receipt write fails, the
                        status is never posted.
--github-status-context GITHUB_STATUS_CONTEXT
                        Commit-status context to post with --post-github-status.
--json                  Output local receipt as JSON

standalone/review-queue:
usage: aragora review-queue [-h]
                            {build,packet,run,act,record-settlement,merge-packet,conductor,evidence-lint,collect-evidence,lint-comment,baseline,observe-outcomes,health,health-alert}
                            ...

Build a prioritized queue of open PRs ready for human review, or
generate an advisory packet for one PR, or settle one PR with an
explicit human action.

Machine review remains advisory only. Settlement writes are human
GitHub reviews/comments plus local founder-review receipts. See
docs/plans/2026-04-19-batched-pr-review-triage.md for the design.

positional arguments:
  {build,packet,run,act,record-settlement,merge-packet,conductor,evidence-lint,collect-evidence,lint-comment,baseline,observe-outcomes,health,health-alert}
    build               Build prioritized review queue from open PRs
    packet              Generate advisory review packet for one PR
    run                 Interactively settle a prioritized PR queue
    act                 Settle one PR with a human action
    record-settlement   Record an already-authorized PR settlement without mutating GitHub
    merge-packet        Print a model-quorum merge authorization packet for a PR batch
    conductor           Build an owner-aware queue conductor packet and next prompt
    evidence-lint       Dry-run whether a proposed evidence comment will count for model quorum
    collect-evidence    Run genuine model reviewers, lint their evidence, post only if tier allows
    lint-comment        Dry-run whether a proposed reviewer comment will count before posting
    baseline            Measure empirical invalidation baseline from on-disk stores (#6375)
    observe-outcomes    Observe post-settlement invalidation signals from GitHub timeline events
                        and (optionally) write them back into v2 outcome fields on settlement
                        receipts. Dry-run by default.
    health              Report freshness across review-queue + proof-loop write surfaces
    health-alert        Edge-triggered alerter: writes an event when proof-loop health changes
                        state

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

standalone/review-queue baseline:
usage: aragora review-queue baseline [-h] [--window-days WINDOW_DAYS] [--min-samples MIN_SAMPLES]
                                     [--safety-margin SAFETY_MARGIN]
                                     [--minimum-meaningful-rate MINIMUM_MEANINGFUL_RATE]
                                     [--placeholder-value PLACEHOLDER_VALUE]
                                     [--calibration-db CALIBRATION_DB]
                                     [--review-queue-root REVIEW_QUEUE_ROOT] [--json]

Read the auto-handle calibration store (failure outcomes) and the
settlement-receipt tree (denominator for human-settled decisions),
compute the empirical invalidation baseline, and propose an auto-
handle invalidation threshold.

Read-only: this command does NOT mutate the calibration store, the
receipt tree, or any threshold configuration. It is the operator-
facing surface for the empirical-threshold framework that landed
in #6602 (phase 1) and #6615 (phase 2 adapter).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --window-days WINDOW_DAYS
                        Measurement-window width in days (default: 30).
  --min-samples MIN_SAMPLES
                        Minimum human-settled sample size before the baseline is considered usable
                        for non-placeholder threshold derivation (default: 50).
  --safety-margin SAFETY_MARGIN
                        Multiplier applied to the baseline when deriving the threshold (default:
                        0.5). Must be in (0, 1].
  --minimum-meaningful-rate MINIMUM_MEANINGFUL_RATE
                        Floor below which threshold drift is indistinguishable from sample noise
                        (default: 0.01).
  --placeholder-value PLACEHOLDER_VALUE
                        Threshold to use when the baseline is below the sample-size floor
                        (default: 0.05, matching the THESIS Commitment 3 placeholder).
  --calibration-db CALIBRATION_DB
                        Override the auto-handle calibration store path. Defaults to the canonical
                        store under aragora's data dir.
  --review-queue-root REVIEW_QUEUE_ROOT
                        Override the review-queue store root used for settlement receipts.
                        Defaults to <repo>/.aragora/review-queue.
  --json                Output the BaselineMeasurement + ThresholdProposal as JSON.

standalone/review-queue record-settlemen:
usage: aragora review-queue record-settlement [-h] [--repo REPO] --head-sha HEAD_SHA --action
                                              {approve,request_changes,comment,admin_squash_merge}
                                              --reason REASON
                                              [--review-queue-root REVIEW_QUEUE_ROOT]
                                              [--apply-post-merge-lane-audit]
                                              [--post-github-status]
                                              [--github-status-context GITHUB_STATUS_CONTEXT]
                                              [--json]
                                              pr

Write a local review-queue settlement receipt after an external
operator decision, such as an exact-head admin squash merge. This
is local-only: it verifies the live PR head/state, writes under
.aragora/review-queue/receipts (or --review-queue-root), and does
not approve, comment, merge, or otherwise mutate GitHub.

positional arguments:
  pr                    PR number or URL

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO           GitHub repo slug override (owner/name). Defaults to current repo context.
  --head-sha HEAD_SHA   Exact PR head SHA that was externally settled.
  --action {approve,request_changes,comment,admin_squash_merge}
                        Externally observed settlement action to record.
  --reason REASON       One-line operator reason or authorization reference.
  --review-queue-root REVIEW_QUEUE_ROOT
                        Override the review-queue store root used for settlement receipts.
                        Defaults to <repo>/.aragora/review-queue.
  --apply-post-merge-lane-audit
                        For admin_squash_merge records, apply merged-PR lane supersession after
                        verifying GitHub reports MERGED and using the live merge commit as the
                        exact guard. Default is dry-run/report only.
  --post-github-status  After the local receipt is durably written, atomically POST the
                        'aragora/human-settlement'=success commit status for the exact head SHA.
                        This is the ONLY GitHub mutation this command performs, and it is the safe
                        replacement for running 'gh api ... statuses' as a separate command: the
                        status can never be set unless the receipt write succeeded first (receipt
                        => status, never status => no receipt). If the receipt write fails, the
                        status is never posted.
  --github-status-context GITHUB_STATUS_CONTEXT
                        Commit-status context to post with --post-github-status.
  --json                Output local receipt as JSON
